sources.citation: Saad, George, Laura Arnold & Emma Peddie. 2024 [rights 2025]. Late Vernacular Production in Island Southeast Asia and the Pacific. Glossa Contact 1: 1-55. doi:10.82012/glossa.contact.2025.saad.et.al (also ANU Open Research hdl:1885/733807897). Open access, CC-BY 4.0.
sources.note: No phonology content. The only Betaf material is Table 2 (pp. 19-20): community-reported age at which children fully understand (5) and fluently produce (10) the vernacular Tena, 'summarised from Lee & Wambaliau 2004', with the remark that 'neither of these surveys are publicly available'. Useful only as (a) confirmation that the Kwanem draft survey report circulates privately (Laura Arnold, ANU; SIL's Randy Lebold grants permission) and (b) its fuller title: 'Draft survey report on the Kwanem languages in northeastern Papua, Indonesia'.
